  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    losses = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_losses = losses * weight\n        loss = ops.sum(weighted_losses) / ops.sum(weight)\n    else:\n        loss = ops.sum(losses)\n    return loss\n"
}

{
  "name": "loss_rankgap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Shift from margin-based pairwise losses to a rank-gap based paradigm using the advantage signals and a smooth tanh link to penalize ranking errors proportionally to rank gap magnitude.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_gap = rank_gap(advantage_w - advantage_l)\nscaled_gap = clamp(alpha * rank_gap, -10, 10)\nloss_per_pair = relu(tanh(scaled_gap) - (log_prob_w - log_prob_l))\nweighted_loss = loss_per_pair * weight\nfinal_loss = mean(weighted_loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_rank_gap",

  },

    ],

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n\n    gap_raw = adv_w - adv_l\n    rg = ops.rank_gap(gap_raw)\n    scaled_rg = ops.clamp(alpha * rg, -10.0, 10.0)\n    link_val = ops.tanh(scaled_rg)\n    diff_log_prob = lpw - lpl\n    raw_loss = ops.relu(link_val - diff_log_prob)\n\n    if weight is not None:\n        raw_loss = raw_loss * weight\n\n    return ops.mean(raw_loss)"
}

  "name": "pairwise_pref_cost_gap",

    log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
    log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']

    abs_gap = ops.abs(cost_gap) + epsilon

  "intuition": "To fix numerical instability due to potentially very small or zero cost_gap values, we clamp the denominator to a minimum epsilon (1e-6) before taking the reciprocal.     cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']

    scaled_diff = diff * weight * scale

    # Clamp scaled_diff to stabilize logsigmoid

    loss = ops.mean(ops.logsigmoid(scaled_diff_clamped))

  "intuition": "Stabilize loss by clamping margin adjusted with advantage_gap and a shift, normalize weights to sum to one for consistent gradients.",
  "pseudocode": "normalized_weight = weight / sum(weight + eps)\nmargin = log_prob_w - log_prob_l\nadjusted_margin = margin + beta * advantage_gap - shift\nclamped_margin = clamp(adjusted_margin, -15, 15)\nloss = -mean(logsigmoid(clamped_margin) * normalized_weight)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_margin",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "logsigmoid",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "clamp_stabilized_normalized",
    "other_hparams": "alpha fixed to 1.0, beta tunable, shift = 0.5"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "logsigmoid",
    "clamp",
    "mean",
    "sum",
    "div"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    eps = 1e-12\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.1)))\n    shift = float(extra.get('shift', 0.5))\n    margin = lpw - lpl\n    adjusted_margin = margin + beta * adv_gap - shift\n    clamped = ops.clamp(adjusted_margin, -15.0, 15.0)\n    weight_sum = ops.sum(weight) + eps\n    normalized_weight = weight / weight_sum\n    loss_per_pair = -ops.logsigmoid(clamped) * normalized_weight\n    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)"
}
